div.div: One national foundation for health data exchange.
div.p: ZM Core defines the reusable FHIR profiles, terminology and implementation guidance that help Zambia's digital health systems exchange consistent, computable health information.

div.div: Standards under active development. This release establishes Zambia's shared interoperability baseline. Implementers should review the release status and validation guidance before production use.

div.h3: A common language for connected care

div.p: ZM Core turns national requirements into implementable FHIR artefacts. It creates consistent expectations for the people, organisations, encounters, clinical information and workflows shared across Zambia's health ecosystem.
Minimum expectations for Patient, Practitioner, Organization, Encounter, clinical and medication resources.
National code systems and value sets that give exchanged information a consistent, computable meaning.
Practical mappings for SmartCare, the Master Facility List and governed health communication workflows.
Conformant examples that show how ZM Core artefacts are used in realistic data-exchange scenarios.
Start with the artifact index to locate the relevant profile, extension, value set or example.
Use the profile definitions and narrative guidance to map local data and build conformant FHIR resources.
Validate resources against the ZM Core package and use the published examples as implementation references.

div.h3: Go directly to the guidance you need

div.p: Move from the national baseline into the implementation details for Zambia's priority systems and exchange patterns.

span.span: Profiles, extensions, code systems, value sets and examples.
Governed communication lanes, channels, consent and audit patterns.
FHIR mappings and workflow guidance for SmartCare interoperability.

div.h3: Built for Zambia's connected health ecosystem
div.p: ZM Core is published by the Zambia Ministry of Health as a common interoperability foundation for national platforms, facility systems and digital health partners.
